acceptance_criteria: All 42,190 source rows and twenty-five season payloads are hash-verified and deterministically dispositioned without changing the corrected candidate populations.

Every retained candidate preserves exact source game/team/side, season/type/week, capture/request/response, row lineage, nested field values, missingness, schema, and reconciliation provenance; source-only rows remain separately quarantined.

All two-sided game pairs preserve offense/defense reciprocity evidence, current/cross-route links, partial seasons, the 2022 coverage boundary, and every negative finding without fabricated thresholds or values.

The gate records historical known-at as unknown, admits no pre-capture PIT feature, and cannot be consumed by preliminary or protected chronological replay without a separate eligible timing contract.
Outputs pass identity, schema-drift, leaf-missingness, chronology, quarantine, mutation, byte-identical rebuild, Jira, repository, provenance, and full-suite validation before Done.
ai_context_notes: No OpenAI output or generated fact may participate in game/team identity, nested statistic values, publication timing, missingness, reciprocity, or validation.
The 2022-2025 same-provider overlap is not independent confirmation; team-box and outcome links establish candidates only and do not validate derived PPA, success, explosiveness, or line-yard truth.
This unit is a capture-time candidate snapshot prerequisite, not historical PIT, preliminary-model, protected, production, or scientific authority.
definition_of_done: Per-season capture-time snapshot and nonadmitted/quarantine artifacts are immutable, content-addressed, reproducible, and externally stored.

Independent reconstruction verifies source hashes, exact populations, unique natural keys, reconciliation states, schema paths, leaf missingness, reciprocity, capture-time authority, mutations, and byte identity.
Canonical/live Jira, Git/PR evidence, governing goal, active plan, cleanup, OpenAI non-use rationale, and all scientific nonclaims agree before Done.
end_to_end_validation: Re-read the corrected candidate manifest, source capture/raw payload identities, accepted outcome and team-box evidence, and all season payloads; rebuild the snapshot in an isolated external root; verify hashes, populations, natural keys, reconciliation dispositions, structural schema, leaf missingness, game-pair reciprocity, partial seasons, capture-time authority, quarantine, forbidden fields, mutation controls, and byte identity; then remove only reconstructible output after validation.

scope: Disposition all 42,190 candidate game-team rows, preserve exact game/team/side evidence and 66 nested field paths, materialize only evidence-supported values, and publish an explicit capture-time eligibility gate with per-season coverage, missingness, reciprocity, and source-only quarantine evidence.

why_this_exists: The corrected advanced-stat candidate spans twenty-five seasons and is a higher-value, lower-identity-risk dependency than the much larger player-box layer. Its immutable capture evidence and team-box/outcome links support deterministic candidate materialization, but its historical publication times are unknown and therefore require a strict non-PIT boundary.
